system.description: When **_the seasons change_**, whoever is friendliest rolls +Fortunes: **on a 10+**, ask the GM 3 questions about the wider world; **on a 7-9**, ask 1 question; **on a 6-**, ask 1 question, but the GM describes some trouble that stems from the inn or its guests.

success.value: Ask the GM 3 questions about the wider world.

failure.value: Ask 1 question, but the GM describes some trouble that stems from the inn or its guests.
